title: 74B model ab 24GB mein - local AI agent
content:
74 BILLION parameter ka model...
sirf 24GB memory mein.
NVIDIA ne launch kiya hai Nemotron 3.5 Bolt.
It is made for local AI agents.
Local matlab... aapki apni machine pe, cloud pe nahi.
74B total parameters...
par ek time pe sirf 9 BILLION active.
That's why it runs fast for its size.
Aur 2-bit compression se ye 24GB mein fit hota hai.
Normally itna bada model kai GPUs maangta.
Here, one good GPU can be enough.
For teams with an NVIDIA GPU... ye Ollama pe available hai.
Web research, writing, code debugging...
sab apni machine pe. CLOUD pe kuch nahi jaata.
No per-token bill. No data leaving the building.
Ab ek honest baat.
Ollama ke page pe likha hai...
Apple Silicon abhi SUPPORTED nahi hai.
So if you're on a Mac like me, this one is not for you yet.
You need an NVIDIA GPU machine for this one.
Main ye nahi bolunga ki maine chala ke dekha... kyunki maine nahi chalaya.
Toh business ke liye ye bada kyun hai?
Socho ek CA firm, ek clinic, ya ek law office.
Client ka data bahar nahi jaana chahiye.
Ab tak unke paas do hi option the...
ya cloud AI use karo, ya AI use hi mat karo.
Now there is a third option.
Private local agent... office ki apni machine pe.
Documents padhe, summaries banaye, research kare...
aur data kahin nahi jaata.
Compression aur smart model design ki wajah se...
powerful AI ab chhote setups mein bhi aa raha hai.
This trend is only going to grow.
Aur agar aap developer ho, toh ye ek naya service idea hai.
Small businesses ko private AI setup chahiye, par unhe pata nahi kaise.
You can be the person who sets it up for them.
Hardware choose karo, model install karo, aur unke documents se connect karo.
That is real AI solutions work.
DM me 'AI' if you want this for your business.
